steps.en: Rejection succeeds and the request is stored as Rejected
steps.id: Penolakan berhasil dan request tersimpan sebagai Rejected

steps.en: The Rejected status is copied to the data the portal reads
steps.id: Status Rejected disalin ke data yang dibaca portal
steps.why_en: If the copy fails it is only logged, so the portal can keep showing Pending.
steps.why_id: Jika penyalinan gagal hanya dicatat di log, sehingga portal bisa tetap menampilkan Pending.

steps.en: OCMS explicitly resends the notice to the portal
steps.id: OCMS secara eksplisit mengirim ulang notice ke portal
steps.why_en: The resend step is an unfinished placeholder; the portal simply stops blocking the notice.
steps.why_id: Langkah kirim ulang hanya placeholder belum jadi; portal hanya berhenti memblokir notice.

steps.en: The owner can furnish the rejected notice again on the portal
steps.id: Owner bisa furnish ulang notice yang ditolak di portal

steps.en: The owner submits new particulars with extra information or proof
steps.id: Owner mengirim particulars baru dengan informasi atau bukti tambahan
